result.title: Analyzing Learned Convnet Features with Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixture Models
result.comment: Presented at NIPS 2016 Workshop: Practical Bayesian Nonparametrics
result.summary: Convolutional Neural Networks (Convnets) have achieved good results in a range of computer vision tasks the recent years. Though given a lot of attention, visualizing the learned representations to interpret Convnets, still remains a challenging task. The high dimensionality of internal representations and the high abstractions of deep layers are the main challenges when visualizing Convnet functionality. We present in this paper a technique based on clustering internal Convnet representations with a Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixture Model, for visualization of learned representations in Convnets. Our method copes with the high dimensionality of a Convnet by clustering representations across all nodes of each layer. We will discuss how this application is useful when considering transfer learning, i.e.\ transferring a model trained on one dataset to solve a task on a different one.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出用 Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixture Model 对 Convnet 各层所有节点的内部表示做无参聚类，以可视化和解释学到的特征，并讨论其在迁移学习中的用途。
AI.relevance_reason: 对内部表示按层做贝叶斯无参聚类，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否形成有语义的簇结构、以及这种结构与深度和位置的关系；但该文只涉及静态视觉特征可视化，与推理期状态生成无直接联系。
